title: Vehicle registration
detail: Submit vehicle registration details at the society office with relevant documentation.

title: Society sticker
detail: Get the society sticker affixed on personal vehicles for identification and security.

title: NBH account setup
detail: Set up your NoBrokerhood account for quarterly maintenance charge payments.

title: Guidelines sign-off
detail: Owner and tenant must sign the society guidelines proforma.

title: Pet policy
detail: Tenants cannot keep pets. Owners with pets must submit a valid vaccination certificate.

title: Parking allotment
detail: Confirm your allotted parking space with the society office.

title: Emergency contacts
detail: Save Maintenance Manager (97042 85706) and Security ASO (90304 93579).

title: Move-in fee
detail: Pay the ₹1,000 move-in charge and inform the Maintenance Manager in advance.
